# Loading in Google Antigravity

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lumitive/lumi-style ~/src/lumi-style
ln -s ~/src/lumi-style ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/lumi-style
# or .agent/skills/lumi-style
```

Invoke: restart the agent session after copying so Antigravity re-detects the skill.

The skill reads `references/` and `tokens/` on demand — no need to attach them manually.

**Symlink rather than copy.** An installed copy silently stranded at 0.1.334 while the repo reached 0.1.337, and a deck was built against three versions of superseded rules. A symlink cannot go stale.

The workspace path is `.agent/skills/` — **singular `agent`** — and is deliberately not the shared `.agents/skills/` convention every other platform here uses. Do not conflate them.

**Restart the agent session after installing** so Antigravity re-detects the skill.

Vendor documentation: https://antigravity.google/docs/skills
